sources.title: GitHub - pratyusha-1310/fake-news-detection: AI-powered fake news ...
sources.snippet: AI-powered fake news detection system using an ensemble ML model (Logistic Regression + Random Forest + SVM) with TF-IDF bigrams and text statistics features. Trained on 2000 synthetic samples. Features a glassmorphic dark-themed frontend with animated scanning, confidence meters, and probability breakdowns.

sources.title: Strengthening False Information Propagation Detection: Leveraging SVM ...
sources.snippet: This work provides a fresh natural language processing method based on Support Vector Machines (SVM) combined with three text vectorizing techniques and a transformer LLM model—more especially, BERT-base—that precisely labels news items as either fake or real.

sources.title: Fake News Detection using NLP and SVM - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a Fake News Detection system using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier. The model classifies news articles as Real or Fake based on their textual content.

sources.title: Fake News Detection using Machine Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Fake news on different platforms is spreading widely and is a matter of serious concern, as it causes social wars and permanent breakage of the bonds established among people. A lot of research is already going on focused on the classification of fake news. Here we will try to solve this issue with the help of machine learning in Python.
